title: Unmanlike
summary: UNMAN'LIKE, UNMAN'LY, adjective 1. Not becoming a human being 2. Unsuitable to a man; effeminate. Unmanly warmth and tenderness of love. 3. Not worthy of a noble mind; ignoble; base; ungenerous; cowar
